title: The Unlocked Locker
story:
After gym class, Jonah found his locker door open. He was sure he had shut it. His sports bag was inside, but his wallet was gone. The wallet held a bus pass and eight euros. He looked along the row and saw nobody. A blue hair tie lay on the floor by his feet, and Jonah never wore hair ties.

He told the coach. The coach asked the class to wait and to show their bags. Most students opened them at once. Elena kept her bag shut and looked at the floor. The coach asked her, in a calm voice, to open it. Elena sighed and took out the wallet. She said the locker had been unlocked and she had taken the wallet to keep it safe until after lunch.

Jonah still felt unsure. The hair tie matched the one in Elena's hair, so she had stood at his locker. The bus pass was still inside, and the money was there too. Her hands shook as she gave it back. The coach said that taking a wallet, even to help, was the wrong choice. Elena apologised, and Jonah took the wallet. Jonah checked the bus pass and counted the coins twice. Elena promised to tell a teacher if she found an open locker again. From that day he checked the lock twice before he left the gym.
